responsibility: Provides tree-SSA loop-pass scaffolding and common loop utilities rather than a single optimization algorithm. It defines pass-group gates and wrapper passes for loop optimization pipelines and OpenACC loop regions, initializes/finalizes loop and SCEV infrastructure, offers shared helpers for traversing indices in memory references, generating temporary names for loop store motion, and estimating loop instruction counts, and acts as the module’s pass-registration and utility hub around the more specialized tree-ssa-loop-* implementations.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the implementation-side hub for common tree-SSA loop infrastructure: pass gates/wrappers, loop/SCEV setup and teardown, and shared utilities like index walking, LSM temporary naming, and loop insn counting. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop.h, it does not define the shared affine_iv/tree_niter_desc types or just declare helpers; it implements the module-level loop scaffolding and utility routines.
